description: An accessibility (axe/WCAG) standard. Static checks verify a11y test files and the `axe-core` devDependency are present. Runtime checks verify `axe.run(container)` returns an empty violations array. There is no auto-fix for accessibility; findings are report-only.

requirements.description: Static accessibility checks must verify the presence of a11y test files and the `axe-core` devDependency. Absence of either must produce a Finding.
requirements.title: Static a11y presence

validation.notes: Absence of a11y test files produces a Finding
A missing axe-core devDependency produces a Finding
A scenario with both a11y tests and axe-core present produces no static a11y Findings
Run ui-health against a scenario missing axe-core and confirm the a11y presence Finding is emitted
The a11y static standard ensures every UI scenario ships accessibility tooling

requirements.description: Runtime accessibility checks must run `axe.run(container)` against the live UI and require the violations array to be empty. Accessibility findings are report-only; no auto-fix is offered.
requirements.title: Runtime axe violations empty

validation.notes: axe.run(container) returning any violation produces a runtime a11y Finding
A11y findings are marked report-only with no autofix_available
An empty axe violations array yields a passing runtime a11y verdict
Run ui-health runtime checks against a UI with a known a11y violation and confirm it is reported
Runtime axe/WCAG validation enforces zero accessibility violations as the standard

title: accessibility (axe/WCAG) standard
